none: PAS NLM-223FB8: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius, 337-350. Possibly dateable to 324-337, Constantius as Caesar. Suggested date: Roman, 330-335. Diameter: 14.55mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: 7. Obverse design: Wreathed head facing Right. Obverse inscription: (…)TANTIVS(…) Reverse design: Two soldiers holding two standards. Cliff Reeves kindly corrects MF’s initial identification
